blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) seized over P425 million worth of fake luxury goods in a series of operations across Metro Manila. According to the NBI, its Intellectual Property Rights Division served search warrants on separate operations conducted at Valenzuela, Manila, Taguig, and Pasay.
